Physical space: A brightly lit, quiet office corridor with plain white walls, light gray floor tiles, and a white metal mesh drop ceiling equipped with recessed circular LED lighting. A large window providing outdoor daylight is visible at the far end of the hallway.
Objects: An open doorway on the right leads into office room C610, containing shared desks, swivel chairs with red fabric accents, desktop monitors, personal bags, water bottles, and cardboard boxes. An access card reader and room plaque are mounted beside the door frame. An umbrella/bag lies on the floor against the left wall.
Screen content: Computer monitors are turned on inside the office room in the background.
Text in the world: A square gray room plaque labeled 'C610' mounted next to the door.
Media being played: None.
Ambient audio: Quiet indoor office background ambiance.
details: I walk straight down the hallway while glancing to my right at the interior of office C610.

action: I continue walking down the hallway, glancing at a utility room door on the left and another doorway on the right.
action_brief: I walk down the hallway.
environment: Moving further down the hallway, a closed white door on the left displays a green-and-white information sheet labeled '弱电间'. On the right wall ahead, an open office door reveals stacked cardboard boxes inside. A dark umbrella rests on the floor beside the right doorway.
details: I maintain a steady walking pace down the center of the corridor.

action: I walk past a floor-to-ceiling glass wall on the left displaying blue graphics and slogans, looking at the elevator lobby.
action_brief: I walk past the elevator lobby glass wall.
environment: A clear glass partition wall appears on the left, decorated with blue decorative vinyl graphics showing university slogans ('立德 立志 立学'), emblems, a drone outline, and architectural motifs. Through the glass, an elevator lobby with warm recessed cove lighting, elevator doors, and small potted plants is visible.
details: I gaze leftward through the glass wall at the slogan lettering and the elevator lobby.

action: I continue walking down the corridor towards the restroom alcove while looking towards the floor and the wall.
action_brief: I walk towards the restroom.
environment: Passing beyond the glass wall, a green illuminated emergency exit sign is mounted low on the left wall. An overhead directional sign with male and female restroom pictograms and a left arrow is mounted on the corner wall ahead.
details: I look downward towards the floor tiles and lower wall as I approach the left turn.

action: I turn left into the restroom entryway corridor, looking at the doorway and the women's restroom doorway curtain.
action_brief: I turn into the restroom entryway.
environment: Turning into a dedicated restroom entryway alcove with light wood door frames. On the left is the open entrance to the men's restroom with a male silhouette icon on the wall and cubicles visible inside. Directly ahead is the entrance to the women's restroom covered by a split gray curtain bearing a female pictogram and the text '女洗手间 WOMEN'.
details: I make a 90-degree left turn to enter the restroom hallway.
